paper_title: Evidence for light-by-light scattering and searches for axion-like particles in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =$ 5.02 TeV
notes: CMS sets 95% CL exclusion limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs ALP mass (5-90 GeV) via gamma-gamma -> a -> gamma-gamma in ultraperipheral PbPb collisions. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma = 1/Lambda). However, the numerical g_agamma vs m_a values are only shown in Fig. 7 (and cross-section limits in Fig. 6) which are not available as a readable table in the provided text. No extractable numerical (mass, coupling) pairs are available.
